mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is 73 degrees under overcast skies at Verona City Hall. Keep an eye on the sky at 8:17 PM tonight to catch the International Space Station passing from the south-southwest toward the east-northeast for 5 minutes. The overnight low will be 69 degrees with rain likely.

The Verona Fire Department invites residents to their open house on September 19 from 10 am to 2 pm at 101 Lincoln Street. It is an opportunity to tour the station, learn about operations, meet the firefighters, and participate in safety activities with food and giveaways.

Today, you can join trivia at Hop Haus or Lake Lou-ee. Tomorrow, the local schedule is busy with the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market, yoga at Insight Wellness, and more trivia options at The Mill, Paddy Mac's, and The Bogey Factory.

On Sunday, August 30, the Verona Police Department began an investigation following a report from the school district regarding an inappropriate relationship involving a staff member in 2019, which led to an arrest on September 4.
Today's flavor of the day is Mint Explosion. The store is currently open and will be serving until 10 pm tonight, so stop by for a scoop while you can.
